pattern: Generated cards are mainly given away when parts of one object or scene do not share a camera. Examples are a side-on body with a turned ring or skewed panels, or a ground disc or prop seen from above next to a level-view hero. Unexplained extreme angles, such as a large visible underside, are the other tell. Generated objects also tend to float or sit whole and centred, while real cards use a calm low three-quarter view, a single level ground and cropping. planar_share rarely decides a pair, because flat or inflated subjects push it out of range on their own. On this vector most pairs stayed weak, and only p06 was a strong call.
